dataset.name: N/A -- live environment/network re-verification, not a dataset benchmark

engine_config.registries_tested: Docker Hub, ghcr.io, AWS public ECR mirror, registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com, quay.io

headline_result.docker_daemon: now functional -- a real change from Phase 6B/6C's 'Docker daemon absent' finding; dockerd starts successfully when launched directly, no systemd needed
headline_result.image_pulls: blocked network-wide across every registry tested -- registry/auth API hosts (ghcr.io, docker hub) are reachable, but their actual blob/CDN storage hosts (production.cloudfront.docker.com, pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com, another CloudFront host) all return 403 Forbidden
headline_result.havenask_registry: registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com remains blocked at the connection level (CONNECT tunnel failed, 403), unchanged from Phase 6B/6C
headline_result.havenask_mirror_search: no Havenask image found on Docker Hub under plausible names (havenask/havenask, alibaba/havenask, havenask/ha3, havenask/suez)
headline_result.net_conclusion: Havenask remains genuinely blocked -- headline verdict unchanged -- but the reason is now more precisely characterized: Docker itself works, but no container image can be pulled via any tested registry, and Havenask's own registry is separately blocked
headline_result.named_limitation: only 4 registries tested, not exhaustive; a from-source Havenask build (bazel route) was not attempted or re-tested in this pass
